summary: Wrote a 4-phase implementation plan for adding desc to the verified 40 desc-less vim.keymap.set calls across 11 active Lua modules. Phases 1-3 are disjoint file groups runnable in parallel (features.lua+neo-tree.lua 19 calls; the two notification modules 10 calls; a 7-file long tail of 11 calls); Phase 4 is a whole-tree confirmation plus full gate sweep. Counts were re-derived at plan-authoring time by a parenthesis-balanced scan (87 total calls, 41 desc-less, 40 genuine) rather than carried from the task description's wrong figure of 44. autopairs.lua (already compliant) and config/keymaps.lua:97 (helper-threaded desc, false positive) are excluded from scope.
